$comment: EVERGREEN COPY ONLY (newsletter name matches the template header: "Notes For Boards") — nothing in this file changes per issue. Everything issue-specific (headline, date, intro, hero image, section list, 'read the full issue' link, archive) is read from the sent campaigns in the Mailchimp folder at build time by src/lib/newsletter.ts. Edit this file only to change the newsletter's name, the standing blurbs, the Ask block, or the fallback hero used when an issue has no large photo of its own.
name: Notes For Boards
description: Notes For Boards is the CMGT newsletter for Gulf South HOA and condo boards — one email a month with plain-English guidance on budgets, reserves, insurance, and HOA law. Read the current issue, browse past issues, or ask us a question.
subscribeBlurb: One email a month, written for volunteer board members across Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Texas, and the Florida Panhandle. No industry-speak, no sales pitch. Unsubscribe anytime.

fallbackHero.alt: An HOA board treasurer working on community finances at a clubhouse table with a laptop open

comingSoon.title: Notes For Boards is on its way.
comingSoon.dek: One email a month for Gulf South HOA and condo boards — plain-English guidance on budgets, reserves, insurance, and the law that governs your community. Subscribe below and the first issue lands in your inbox.

ask.title: Ask CMGT a question
ask.body: About this issue, your budget, your reserves, or anything else on your board's plate. No question is too small — whether CMGT manages your community today or your board is weighing a change. A CMGT community manager answers personally, usually within one business day.
prompts: Why did our insurance renewal jump this year?
Do we have to raise assessments?
ask.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Our insurance renewal came in 40% higher than last year. What are our options before we consider a special assessment?
